header: 2How to Train an Adaptive Teacher LLM?

images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of our framework. The teacher interacts with student archetypes through preparation, tutoring, and testing, and receives a reward for tutoring based on the student’s improvement. The student archetype is implemented by a backbone model with a gating mechanism.

Figure 3:Student archetype comparisons between our design and prompted students. Panels (a–b) show student improvement, and panels (c–d) show complaint rates. A good student archetype design should show higher improvement and lower complaint rate over the diagonal, as the students should complain without improvement when the teacher strategy and student preference is unmatched.
Figure 5:Student improvement (percentage points) under six fixed teaching strategies with three different student backbones without adaptive gates.
